scope: Auth UI only; source and static validation, no new build/device/simulator execution

construction.scope: all self-maintained app and JobsIM Pods; other-owner issues reported, not edited

chains: heuristic all-source log retained; dsl_methods=0 and domain receiver repetitions are not blanket product defects or a pass claim

background.source: Commons / James Wheeler / CC0 / original 2017, source record maintained by root
background.video: bundled optional, source only; muted and lifecycle-paused

contracts.remember: profile-specific; no automatic login, success + same connection + verified pair; no demo password persistence
contracts.demo: dedicated service API and same-profile RAM candidate, cleartext prefill; explicit login
contracts.settings: independent navigation push; original TLS/CA/descriptor confirmation preserved
contracts.authUnknownResult: original proof prompt and request retry preserved; new connection clears old UI request signature
